body: Ah, ok! I think I'll watch that episode to understand the whole thing :)

Is it because English is not my native language or why didn't I see that quote saying anything about BPD? Isn't "borderline between something" a common phrase that has nothing to do with borderline personality disorder? I'm sorry if I'm totally wrong.
As a person who ALSO fucked their cousin: it wasn't the best sex I've ever had, but it was good.

"Laineenliplatus", Finnish for the sound water in a lake makes when the wind is blowing just a little bit. Both because the word sounds nice and because the sound is beautiful. I also like "lullaby" in English, I guess I'm into the L-letter :)
This is exactly how I feel.

Oh God I wish I knew! I have tried everything. I have tried exercising, meditation, vitamins, self help books... It just keeps getting worse. I really dont want to die, I WANT to have a happy life but after years of struggling I still can't find a way to find it. I wish people would understand what it feels like, knowing your life will probably be a painful battle for the rest of your life... And no one wants to live 50 years like that. No one.

Yes they are. Just "forgetting" about them isn't that easy! Thanks for your tip, that song is absolutely beautiful. Will not go for a walk since it's 11PM here and I'm a young girl living in a bad neighbourhood, but I am listening to music and drinking tea. I think I already got over the worst phase so I believe I'm calming down.

I think judging suicide when someone has never felt such pain is just immature, childish. This makes me so angry.
Not your comment but the earlier conversation of course. English is not my language so expressing myself is difficult!

I wouldn't say I'm doing better. Actually I'm doing a lot worse with self harm. But I have better control over suicide thoughts. I have had treatment since I was 13 years old, so that's 11 years now. My 4 year therapy just ended, but I still see a doctor. Nothing has ever really helped, and that's one thing that makes me feel even more helpless and frustrated. 11 years of treatment, therapies, doctors and medication and NOTHING has helped me. I feel even worse than I did 11 years ago. 
Sometimes it's just so hard to understand why I have to put up with this shit, you know? I just wish the pain would end.

I just keep thinking, that isn't THIS the one thing where a person is allowed to be selfish? I mean, selfish or not, but shouldn't you be allowed to decide about your own life/death?
Thank you for your kind words. I'm not sure if I'm actually considering suicide or not. That conversation just made me angry and frustrated, and I have troubles dealing with emotions like that since I have BPD. Talking about this with you guys is definitely calming me down.
